note: USGS Quaternary Fault and Fold Database traces whose fault_name contains San Andreas, with original section identities and gaps retained. Line geometry is simplified with a 300 m horizontal tolerance for this regional display; original vertices and fragments are pinned in the source. The bright trace is a widened cartographic symbol, not a chasm or measured fault-zone width. Relief is exaggerated 5 times. The source includes multiple mapped strands; their aggregate linework is not a single traversable route. The separate approximate 1,210 km ruler represents the catalog system length and is not used to rescale the coordinates. Horizontal coordinates are not normalized to the catalog size. Colors are illustrative. The opaque sides and flat underside are arbitrary display cuts, not real cliffs or geological strata. Mapzen / Tilezen; SRTM, GMTED2010 and United States 3DEP terrain courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey; ETOPO1 ocean bathymetry courtesy of NOAA; Natural Earth public-domain map data; adaptation by Universe Scales. Ocean depths are sampled explicitly from NOAA ETOPO1 (1 arc-minute), using Natural Earth coastlines to select ocean samples; coastlines and land/ocean source transitions are generalized.
